title: Analytics Dashboard
summary: Ingests operational events and derives collection metrics, waste mix, resolution times and worker activity.

trade.notes: Push-based: derives everything from events it is sent and never reads another module's database. Portable to any operator willing to emit the documented event shapes.

settlement.counterparty_note: COMPLETE AT SIGNING — no counterparty agreed at the time of writing.
settlement.rationale: Push-based and vertical-agnostic — any operator emitting the documented event shapes can adopt it, which widens the buyer pool beyond waste.

licence_back.why: bin_reporting and worker_dashboard both consume this module's capability. Divesting without a licence-back would stop the product on settlement day.

settlement.post_sale_operation: Continue against our own instance under the licence-back, or repoint the consumer's capability env var at the buyer's hosted endpoint. No code change either way.
